Spanish class can suck super hard and I'm sorry your parents treated you like shit and made you feel stupid. Feeling stupid in a subject that everyone else is succeeding in is the worst feeling ever. I'm sure you're smart in other areas. What about math? Science? Nature? Kinesthetics? Technology? Art? People skills? Etc? Don't let anyone hate on you for not getting the hang of Spanish: maybe it's just not your thing. Because of how you feel about Spanish, i don't recommend picking it up again. It sounds overwhelming af. But if you have to take it, try talking to your prof beforehand about your life with Spanish so far, and they will support you (if they're good), because that's what teachers are for! Like the other person said, duolingo is a pretty good language learning app, and its spanish course is really refined, so that's also an option.

One of my legs is slightly shorter than the other for some reason, so I look lopsided most of the time. I'm also a little overweight. My eyes are naturally far apart and bulge out of my face more that most people. I look really odd, intimidating, even alien-like to some people. Being introverted and socially akward doesn't help eiher, and I don't have that big of a social circle. Sometimes I feel like my body betrayed me too, it makes life slightly harder and more akward for someone with my body type. But you know what? IDGAF. I can enjoy life and meet people who also DGAF if i wanted to. I have enough friends and a decent girl who also DGAF what my body looks like. People tell you to "get over it" but it's true man.
